datasets.title: Remittances received and paid, and the cost of sending money, by country
datasets.description: Personal remittances received (US$ million and % of GDP) and paid, latest year to 2025; average cost of sending $200 to and from each country covered by RPW, Q3 2025 and Q3 2017.

datasets.title: World remittance flows and the global average cost, 2000 to 2025
datasets.description: Personal remittances received by all countries and by low- and middle-income countries, remittances paid, and the global average cost of sending $200 (Q3 of each year).

datasets.title: Average cost of sending $200 by quarter, Q2 2016 to Q3 2025
datasets.description: Global average, fee and exchange-rate margin, averages by provider type, and the average from the UK, calculated from the RPW dataset.

datasets.title: Average cost of sending $200 to each SDG region, 2011 to 2025
datasets.description: SDG indicator 10.c.1 by receiving region, third quarter of each year.

datasets.title: Cost of sending $200 in each corridor, Q3 2025
datasets.description: Average total cost (and in Q3 2016), SmaRT average, fee and exchange-rate margin, services surveyed, cheapest service, and averages for banks and money transfer operators.

datasets.title: Cost of sending $200 by provider type, payment method and access point, Q3 2025
datasets.description: Simple averages over services, calculated from the RPW dataset; categories with fewer than 20 services left out.

datasets.title: Personal remittances paid and received by the UK, 2000 to 2025
datasets.description: US$ million, from the World Bank's World Development Indicators.

datasets.title: Average cost of sending $200 from the UK and worldwide, 2011 to 2025
datasets.description: SDG indicator 10.c.1, third quarter of each year.

datasets.title: Map classes
datasets.description: Bands used to colour the three maps.

datasets.title: Headline findings
datasets.description: Published figures from the World Bank's Remittance Prices Worldwide report for Q3 2025 and the text of SDG target 10.c.
